name: adsb
label: ADS-B / Mode S (1090 MHz)
description: Decode aircraft transponder messages from the 1090 MHz ADS-B band — Mode S short and extended squitters, including DF17 ADS-B position / velocity / identification frames. Wraps a vendored dump1090 (antirez classic). Decoded frames stream into the Logs tab under the `decoder::adsb` category. Tune the SDR to 1090 MHz; the decoder is hard-locked to 2 MS/s. The channelizer integer-decimates higher source rates (2/4/6/8/10 MS/s) down to 2 MS/s — set the source to one of those rates and the orange channel band on the waterfall will mark the 2 MHz ADS-B chunk being decoded. A wide UHF antenna with line-of-sight to the sky is the biggest single factor in catch rate.
